identifier.description: The prefix of the issue numbers in the team, for example "ENG".

cyclesMode.description: With `auto`, the server makes, closes and continues the cycles. With `manual`, a person makes each cycle.

autoRolloverDestination.description: Where the unfinished issues go when the server closes a cycle. Only the `auto` mode uses it.

cyclesFrequency.description: The length of a cycle, in weeks.

upcomingCycles.description: The number of future cycles that the server keeps.

teamType.description: The workflow states that a new team gets. Only creation uses it.
